rationale: Extended corpus for 'does this construction occur in the wild' checks -- the third fixture category (spec §10). Distinct from trimmed fixtures (guard regressions) and acceptance fixtures (does this parse correctly). Chosen for DRAFTING-STYLE variety across shops -- tax, emergency, appropriations, defense authorization, infrastructure, reconciliation -- because that variety is what surfaced the VAWA/WRDA intro-<quote> mislabels (0/53 on acceptance fixtures, 2/571 here). Grow by widening STYLE, not volume; the obvious uncovered axes are chamber (these skew House/enrolled) and vintage (114th and earlier predate parts of the Bill DTD). F4 added the first REPORTED versions (rh/rs): committee change-tracking markup (changed="added"/"deleted", reported-display-style, <deleted-phrase>) is declared by the Bill DTD but occurs in NO enrolled, engrossed, or introduced version -- measured 0 across enr/eh/es/is probes, and present in 38 of 80 sampled reported packages. A corpus without a reported version cannot see it at all.
source: https://api.govinfo.gov/packages/{package_id}/xml (X-Api-Key; enrolled text is immutable so sha256 is stable)

FY2024 NDAA as reported in the House -- large reported bill, House committee style, widens the chamber axis the manifest rationale names as uncovered. Carries changed="added"/reported-display-style but no changed="deleted", so it pins the ADDED half of the change-tracking markup.

FY2026 NDAA as reported in the House. Paired with the already-cached BILLS-119hr3838eh so the corpus carries a CONFIRMED two-version pair of the same bill -- 693 shared section ids, 15 of which differ in text. Grounds S17's E3 (version disambiguation), which previously presupposed an enrolled version that does not exist: govinfo lists ih, rh, eh only.
